questions.question: She aspires _____ a scientific career.
questions.explanation: Aspire to: আকাঙ্ক্ষা করা। Aspiration হচ্ছে noun, এরপর for বসে। Aspire হচ্ছে verb, এরপর to বসে।

questions.question: Your conduct admits ____ no excuse.
questions.explanation: Admit of: স্বীকৃতি পাওয়া। Admit to: ভর্তি হওয়া। Admit into: যোগ দেওয়া।

questions.question: The mother was anxious _____ the safety of her son.
questions.explanation: Anxious about: কোন বিষয়ে উদ্বিগ্ন। Anxious for: কোন কিছুর জন্য উদ্বিগ্ন।

questions.question: Dogs have antipathy ____ cats.
questions.explanation: Antipathy to someone or something: কোন কিছুর প্রতি বিদ্বেষ। Antipathy against: কারও প্রতি বিদ্বেষ।

questions.question: He pleaded ....... me for justice.
questions.explanation: Plead with: কাকুতি-মিনতি করা।

questions.question: A new moon hung _______ the mountains.
questions.explanation: Hang around: ঘোরাঘুরি করা।

questions.question: He prohibited me _____.
questions.explanation: Prohibit from doing something: কোন কিছু করতে নিষেধ করা।

questions.question: Why are you so angry _____?
questions.explanation: Angry with: কোন ব্যক্তির উপর রাগ করা। Angry about: কোন বস্তুর উপর রাগ করা। Angry for: কোন কারণে রাগ করা।

questions.question: Hurry up! We have to go ____ five minutes.
questions.explanation: Point of time এ by হয়। Period of time এ in হয়। In 5 minutes।

questions.question: He parted _____ his friends in tears.
questions.explanation: Part from: বিচ্ছেদ হওয়া।

questions.question: The children were entrusted ____ the care of their uncle.
questions.explanation: Entrust to: কারও উপর কারো বা কোন কিছুর দায়িত্ব প্রদান করা।

questions.question: Rizvi requested Rimi _____ telephone to attend the meeting.
questions.explanation: ফোনের মাধ্যমে কোনো কাজ করা over the phone বা by telephone হবে (Be verb না থাকলে)। ফোনে কথা বলছে অবস্থায় on the phone (Be verb থাকলে)।

questions.question: Please pass the book _______ her when you've finished reading it.
questions.explanation: Pass on: অতিক্রম করা, হস্তান্তর করা।

questions.question: Cultural exchanges are a way of building bridges ___ countries.
questions.explanation: পারস্পরিক সম্পর্ক বুঝতে দুইয়ের অধিকের মাঝও between হয়।

questions.question: I went here ___ a helicopter.
questions.explanation: যে সব যানবাহনে চলাচল করা সম্ভব না সেসব যানবাহনের আগে In বসে। in a car, in a taxi, in a helicopter। যানবাহনের সাথে Article না থাকলে By: By bus, By train।

questions.question: Japan is ____ the east of Bangladesh.
questions.explanation: সীমানার মধ্যে হলে In। সীমানার বাইরে হলে To - Japan is to the east of Bangladesh। সীমানার উপরে হলে On।

questions.question: He ran ___ the building.
questions.explanation: He ran into the building means he entered the building while running.

questions.question: The plane flew ___ the clouds.
questions.explanation: The plane flew under the clouds.

questions.question: Do you know the solution ___ the problem?
questions.explanation: Solution to something: কোন কিছুর সমাধান অর্থে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: Rahim paid the salary ___ cheque.
questions.explanation: Paid in cash। Paid by cheque।

questions.question: He stopped ___ London on the way ___ New York.
questions.explanation: destination এর পূর্বে to বসে। Journey করার সময় কোনো শহরে থেকে যাওয়া বা যাত্রা বিরতি বোঝাতে শহরের পূর্বে at বসে।

questions.question: The cat ___ a rat.
questions.explanation: Run at: পিছনে পিছনে দৌড়ানো/তাড়া করা।

questions.question: Please don't ____ on your payments.
questions.explanation: Fall back: পিছানো/বিলম্ব করা।

questions.question: Everyone admires him __ his success.
questions.explanation: Admires of: প্রশংসা করা।

questions.question: They live ____ catching fish.
questions.explanation: Live by: জীবিকা নির্বাহ করা।

questions.question: It is difficult to sympathize ______ an unfortunate man.
questions.explanation: Sympathize with someone: কারো প্রতি সহানুভূতিশীল হওয়া।

questions.question: The bus was late this morning, but it is usually _____.
questions.explanation: নির্দিষ্ট সময় বুঝাতে on time বসে। নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের পূর্বে বা পরে বুঝাতে in time বসে।

questions.question: He is resolved ____ going away.
questions.explanation: Resolved on: দৃঢ়প্রতিজ্ঞ।

questions.question: Professor Kamal is an authority ____ Sociology.
questions.explanation: Authority on something: কোন বিষয়ে বিশেষ জ্ঞানসম্পন্ন।

questions.question: He persists ____ disturbing me.
questions.explanation: Persist in: নেতিবাচক হওয়া সত্বেও অবস্থায় অনড় থাকা।

questions.question: As she was talking, he suddenly broke __________, saying, 'That's a lie!'
questions.explanation: Break in: কথার মাঝে কথা বলা; চলমান কোন কিছুতে হস্তক্ষেপ করা। Break off: সাময়িকভাবে থামা। Break down: ভেঙে পড়া। Break into: বলপূর্বক প্রবেশ করা।

questions.question: Eight men were concerned ________ the plot.
questions.explanation: Concerned in: সংশ্লিষ্ট/জড়িত। Concerned for: উদ্বিগ্ন।

questions.question: You cannot do this _ your home.
questions.explanation: বাড়িতে বোঝাতে at home কিংবা in my home/in your home ব্যবহার করা যাবে।

questions.question: Nabiha is confined _ a room for five days.
questions.explanation: কক্ষে আবদ্ধ থাকা অর্থে Confined in বসে।

questions.question: We arrived _ time to get good seats.
questions.explanation: ব্যাপক সময়ের শেষ মুহূর্তে In। Mahbub will do the work in a month।

questions.question: No one could tell whether he was ____ earnest or ___ jest.
questions.explanation: Jest at: ঠাট্টা। In jest: মজার ছলে। In earnest: in a serious way.

questions.question: What are you so angry _____ ?
questions.explanation: কোনো ব্যক্তির (somebody) ওপর রাগান্বিত হলে angry এর সাথে with/at বসে। কোনো কিছু নিয়ে রাগান্বিত হলে angry এর সাথে about বসে।

questions.question: Please ________ the necessity of arriving early.
questions.explanation: Emphasise (verb) এর পর কোনো preposition হবে না।

questions.question: Are you doing anything special __________ the weekend?
questions.explanation: weekend এর পূর্বে at ব্যবহার হয়। at the weekend হলো British English। on the weekend (American English) ও সঠিক।

questions.question: The word 'seek' is closest ___ meaning of pursue.
questions.explanation: pursue in means "continue or proceed along" that is same as "seek".

questions.question: Anis had a talent ___ making people laugh.
questions.explanation: Talent এর পর for বসে। talent for: প্রতিভা/দক্ষতা।

questions.question: Excess working can be fatal ____ health.
questions.explanation: ধ্বংসাত্মক কিছু বোঝাতে fatal to হয়।

questions.question: The whole case hinges ___ this point.
questions.explanation: hinge upon: নির্ভর করা।

questions.question: Don't trespass ____ my land.
questions.explanation: trespass on/upon: অনাধিকার প্রবেশ।

questions.question: He sprang quickly ____ action.
questions.explanation: Quickly on: চমকে দেওয়া।

questions.question: ___ sharks, whales and dolphins are warm blooded mammals.
questions.explanation: unlike something: কোন কিছুর মতো না।

questions.question: The government has stepped ____ measures to curb swine flu.
questions.explanation: step up: গতি বাড়ানো।

questions.question: My father called me many times ________ .
questions.explanation: রাতের নির্দিষ্ট সময় বোঝাতে 'in the night' ব্যবহৃত হয়। সম্পূর্ণ রাত বোঝাতে at হয়।

questions.question: The criminal died _____ the scaffold.
questions.explanation: Die on = ফাঁসির মঞ্চে মারা যাওয়া। Die at = পণ করে মারা যাওয়া। Die for = দেশের জন্য মারা যাওয়া।

questions.question: He was disappointed _____ my attitude.
questions.explanation: Disappointed + in/at = আমরা যা আশা করেছিলাম তা না হওয়ায় হতাশ। Disappointed + of = অন্যদিক থেকে কিছু পেতে ব্যর্থ হলে।

questions.question: The criminal has been warned many times _____ his wrongdoing.
questions.explanation: 'against' ব্যবহার করা হয় যদি কাউকে তার অবৈধ কার্যকলাপের জন্য সতর্ক করা হয়।

questions.question: A defect can be caused __________ negligence by one of the members of a team.
questions.explanation: Caused by negligence অর্থ অবহেলাজনিত কারণে।

questions.question: The children are _____ the river.
questions.explanation: Sea, river, Lake ইত্যাদির পূর্বে in/at উভয়ই ব্যবহৃত হতে পারে। In ব্যবহৃত হলে পানির মধ্যে থাকা বোঝায়। At ব্যবহৃত হলে পানির কাছাকাছি বোঝায়।

questions.question: Samantha has already written _______ the principle application.
questions.explanation: Write এরপর বস্তুবাচক objective থাকলে preposition হয় না। তবে Write to a person হয়।

questions.question: The shirt will be exchanged _____ Bangladeshi taka.
questions.explanation: Exchange + for + something: He will exchange pounds for dollar। Exchange + with + something: Would you exchange the marker with your teacher।

questions.question: On the night before the exam, she was seen poring _____ the books.
questions.explanation: Pore over / Poring over = reading it with great attention বা কোন কিছু সতর্কতার সাথে পড়া।

questions.question: Ratna unnecessarily _____ a quarrel with Rekha and left the party.
questions.explanation: Pick a quarrel with somebody মানে কারো সাথে ঝগড়া করা।

questions.question: It's time for you to give _____ your examination papers.
questions.explanation: Give in: যথাযথ কর্তৃপক্ষের হাতে তুলে দেওয়া।

questions.question: The speaker was not clear and I couldn't make ___ what he meant.
questions.explanation: Make out (Phrasal verb): manage with some difficulty to see or hear someone or something. অর্থ: বুঝতে পারা।

questions.question: The flowers withered _____ the hot sun.
questions.explanation: 'Under' means the process of being affected or controlled by a particular action, situation, or state.

questions.question: You must dispense _____ his services.
questions.explanation: Dispense with: to get rid of or do without something.

questions.question: It was ____ midnight when three cars dropped ____ the passengers and disappeared.
questions.explanation: Around means nearly at. Drop off: to take someone or something to a particular place.

questions.question: His family comprises _____ nine members.
questions.explanation: 'Comprise' is a transitive verb meaning 'to consist of'. It takes a direct object without any preposition.

questions.question: It rests _______ the management to justify our actions.
questions.explanation: 'Rest with' means 'to be the responsibility of someone'. 'It rests with the management' means it is their responsibility.

questions.question: She prides herself ___ her ability to remain calm under pressure.
questions.explanation: The fixed collocation is 'pride oneself on something'. 'On' is the standard correct preposition here.

questions.question: SAARC is a treaty _____ eight countries.
questions.explanation: 'Between' is used for defined distinct parties individually, even if more than two. SAARC is a treaty between eight specific named countries.

questions.question: In which sentence is the word 'since' used as a preposition?

options.a: I have not seen him since.
options.b: Nine months have passed since I met him.
options.c: Since he was tired, he could not wait for you.
options.d: Till now since his birth, he has not been taken care of by his parents.

questions.correct_answer_text: Till now since his birth, he has not been taken care of by his parents.
questions.explanation: In option d, 'since' is followed by a noun phrase ('his birth'), making it a preposition. In other options, 'since' acts as an adverb or conjunction.

questions.question: He was standing ______ a crowd of children.
questions.explanation: 'Among' is used when something is in the middle of a group of more than two. Since there is a crowd of children, 'among' is correct.

questions.question: Each union elects several delegates ______ the annual conference.
questions.explanation: 'To' shows direction/purpose. 'Elect delegates to' is the correct collocation — delegates are elected to attend the conference.

questions.question: Satyendranath was a contemporary ____ Rabindranath Tagore.
questions.explanation: The correct collocation is 'contemporary of' — meaning belonging to the same period. We say 'a contemporary of' a person.
